<entry id="R00222">
<head-word>(צָיַץ) צָוַץ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (apocop. of צוצו = צפצף); 
<italic>Pi.</italic> צִיוֵּץ, צִיוֵּוץ, 
<italic>Pilp</italic>.</definition>
<notes> צִוְצֵי 
<italic>to chirp</italic>. Koh. R. to I, 1 צפור מְצַוֵּיץ ויורע על מה מצויץ when a bird chirped, he (Solomon) knew what it chirped for; Cant. R. to I, 1 מְצַוְצֵי (Yalk. Kings 175 מצפצף). Lev. R. s. 6 (expl. המצפצפים, Is. VIII, 19) המְצַוְּוצִין or המְצַיְּיצִין (not המציינין); Yalk. Is. 281 דמצייצ' (read המ'). Gen. R. s. 65 אם מצאתם … מְצַיְּצִין בקולם וכ' Ar. (ed. a. Var. Ar. מצפצפין) if you find there school children chirping with their voices, you cannot attack them (the Jews). Ib. בזמן שקולו של יעקב מצוי וכ' (read: מְצַוֵּיץ; Ar. s. v. מצוי: מצויין, cler. error for מְצַוֵּיץ; Var. מצפצף) when the voice of Jacob chirps in the synagogues, the hands are not Esau’s hands (they have no power over Jacob). Tosef. Sabb. VI (VII), 15 המְצַיֶּצֶת לאורז (not לאוזן, v. ed. Zuck. note), v. צָוַוח.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00223">
<head-word>צְוַץ</head-word>
<head-word>צְיַץ</head-word>
<language-key> ch.,</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Pa.</italic> צַיֵּיץ, צַיֵּיץ, (
<italic>Palp</italic>.</definition>
<notes> צַיְצֵי) same. Pesik. Dibré, p. 110
<sup>b</sup> (expl. צהלי, Is. X, 30) צַיְּיצִי בקלך Ar. (ed. Koh. צַיְּצִי; ed. שישי קולך); Yalk. Is. 284 ציצי קולך chirp with thy voice (let thy voice chirp, in studying the Law); v. לַבְלֵב. Nidd. 42
<sup>b</sup> שמעית ולד דצַוֵּיץ וכ' (Ar. דצייץ) I heard the infant squeak at sunset-time, but it was not born &c. Koh. R. to XII, 4 כד שמע … מְצַוְצְיָין וכ' (some ed. מצוייצן, corr. acc.) when he hears the birds chirp, he thinks robbers are coming &c.; Yalk. ib. 979 מְצַיְּיצִין. Lev. R. s. 16 ציפוריא מציצין Ar. (Var., a. ed. קולנין). [Yalk. Is. 281, v. preced.].—Trnsf. (of the singing of boiling water) 
<italic>to boil</italic>. B. Mets. 29
<sup>b</sup> אלא דלא צַיֵּיץ only when the water has not been steaming (Ar. מְצַוְּיָין Ms. F. צַוְיַת; Ms. R. 2 מְצַוְּיַת, v. צְוֵי I); Ḥull. 84
<sup>b</sup> צַיֵּיץ Ar. (ed. צַיֵּץ).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00224">
<head-word>צוּץ</head-word>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> (b. h.; = צאצא</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, v. 
<xref rid="J00515">יָצָא</xref>) 
<italic>to come forth; to shine; to bloom</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵצִיץ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bloom, sprout</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to XII, 5 מהיכן אדם מֵצִין some ed. (oth. מֵנֵיץ, v. נָצַץ) from what part of the body will man sprout forth (at resurrection)? Yalk. ib. 979 משעה שהוא מֵצִיץ (Koh. R. l. c. 7 משיניץ) from the time of blooming; Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause sprouting</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 28 מהיכן הקב"ה מציץ וכ' from what part will the Lord cause man to sprout forth?, v. supra; Lev. R. s. 18; Yalk. Koh. l. c. מכין (corr. acc.).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to look out, peep</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 67
<sup>a</sup> היו מְצִיצִין ורואין וכ' they looked out to see &c.; R. Hash. 31
<sup>b</sup>. Ḥag. 14
<sup>b</sup>, a. e., v. פָּגַע. Ḥull. 47
<sup>b</sup> הֵצַצְתִּי בו I looked at him. Pirké d’R. El. ch. XIX והֵצִיצוּ וכ', v. פּוֹעֵל; a. fr.—Yoma 35
<sup>b</sup> הֵצִיצוּ עיניהן they 
<italic>made</italic> their eyes 
<italic>look</italic> around (Ms. M. 2 הציצו only).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּצָץ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be made to bloom; to break forth</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 66
<sup>a</sup> (in a historical fragment) וַתּוּצַץ הרעה ע''י וכ' and the evil broke forth (took its start) through the agency of Elazar &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>צִיֵּיץ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of צִיצִית) 
<italic>to provide with show-fringes</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 131
<sup>a</sup> אם צ' טליתו (Ms. M. עשה ציץ לט') if he put fringes on his cloak (on the Sabbath).—Part. pass. מְצוּיָּיץ; f. מְצוּיֶּיצֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְצוּיָּיצִין; מְצוּיָּיצוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. 25
<sup>b</sup> סדינין המצ' linen cloaks provided with woolen fringes. Men. 43
<sup>a</sup>. Pesik. R. s. 15; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (צִיץ
<language-key> ch.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083">cmp. meanings</xref></language-reference> of נֵץ a. נִיצוֹץ) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> צ' דנורא 
<italic>ray of light</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 73
<sup>a</sup>; Yalk. Is. 337; Yalk. Jer. 276 צ' דנ' חוורתי a ray of whitish light. Taan. 25
<sup>a</sup> נפיק צ' דנ' וכ' a ray of light proceeded from his forehead; (Ms. M. also צָצוּתָא). Sabb. 56
<sup>b</sup> נתן דצ' Nathan ‘with the ray of light’ (a repentant sinner with a halo; oth. opin. whom an angel seized by his 
<italic>forelock</italic>, v. infra, afterwards known as (Mar) Ukba, the Resh Galutha; v. Rashi to Snh. 31

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>forelock</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Men. 42
<sup>a</sup> וצריך לפורדה כי צ' וכ' (Ms. R. 2, a. Rashi צִיצִי') he must separate it (the show-fringe) like the forelock of the gentiles; Yalk. Num. 750 ציצו'.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>tail</italic> of a mouse.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 121
<sup>b</sup> נקוטו בצוּצִיתֵיה ואפקוה (not ואפקיה) take it by its tail and carry it out; Bets. 36
<sup>b</sup> (corr. acc.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00231">
<head-word>צוֹצְלָא</head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= צלצל'; צַלְצֵל) 
<italic>a species of-small turtle doves</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 75
<sup>a</sup> השתא כביעתא דצוצלא וכ' Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. צִיצְלָא; Rashi צוצילתא; Ms. M. צִלְצְלָא; Ms. R. צִילְ'; Ms. H. צִילְצוּלָא; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) we do not even find a jewel as large as the egg of a dove, and (you say) we shall find jewels of such sizes?; Snh. 100
<sup>a</sup> צוּלְצְלָא Ms. M. (ed. צִילְצְלָא; Ms. K. צִוּלְצִילְתָּא; Ms. F. צוצילתא; Pesik. ʿAniya, p. 137
<sup>a</sup> שפנינא). Sabb. 80
<sup>b</sup> צלצלתא Ms. M. (ed. צילצלא, צִילְצְלֵי 
<plural-form>pl.; Ms. O. צוצילתא;</plural-form> v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00240">
<head-word>צוּר</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> צהר; cmp. טוּר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>rock</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 15 ומצא שם צ' גדול and found there a large rock; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. צוּרִים</plural-form>. Ib. כאן … על הצ' הללו here I will build the fortress, on these rocks.—[Tosef. Pes. VII, 13 שומרי צו' ed. Zuck., read: צִירִים, v. צִיר II).—Trnsf. [
<italic>Protection</italic>,] 
<italic>the Lord</italic>; (in Agadah derived from יָצַר; v. next w.) 
<italic>the Creator</italic>. Ber. 5
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Job XVIII, 4) אין צ' אלא הקב"ה 
<italic>tsur</italic> means the Holy One &c. (with ref. to Deut. XXXII, 18). Lev. R. s. 23 (ref. to Deut. l. c.) התשתם … יוצר you have weakened the power of the Creator. Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLIII מרד בצ' עליון rebelled against the Rock on high; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00241">
<head-word>צוּר</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. יָצַר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to turn</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to tie around, wrap</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 49
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. וכי לָצוּר על פי וכ' does one want a document to tie around his flask?, i.e. does one care for a paper except for the value it represents? Koh. R. to VIII, 8 (ref. to Zech. XII, 1 ויצר) צָר רוח של אדם בגופו he tied up the spirit of man in his body, v. צָרַר; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to form, shape</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 75
<sup>b</sup> הצָר צורה בכלי he who draws a figure on a vessel. Ib. 103
<sup>b</sup> עד שיָצוּר כולו until he has drawn the entire figure which he intended to draw. Gen. R. s. 7, beg.; Yalk. ib. 11 מדת בו"ד צר צורה … יכול לצור צורה במים (not מלך) a human being draws a design on land, can he draw a design in water?; Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 8. Lev. R. s. 14 לשני ציירין זה צר דמותו וכ' like two painters, one paints the likeness of one &c.; a. fr.—Zeb. 94
<sup>a</sup>, v. infra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (with על) 
<italic>to surround, besiege</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Deut. 203 אין צָרִים על עיר וכ' we must not begin the siege of a town later than three days before the Sabbath; a. e.—[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>4)</number>
<definition> (cmp. זוּר) 
<italic>to press</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="R00448">צִיר I</xref>.</definition>
<notes>]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>צִיֵּיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to draw, paint; to embroider</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Zeb. 94
<sup>a</sup> בגד עליו לצַיְּירוֹ … Rashi (ed. עליה לצוּרָהּ; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> a garment which one intends to embroider.—Part. pass. מְצוּיָּיר, מְצוּיָּר;
<pos> f.</pos> מְצוּיֶּירֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְצוּיָּירִים, מְצוּיָּירִין; מְצוּיָּירוֹת, מְצוּיָּר'</plural-form>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 12; Cant. R. to VI, 4 (not צוויינות); Yalk. Num. 713 (not מצויינות), v. צָב I.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="R00242">
<head-word>צוּר</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to tie around</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 48
<sup>a</sup>; Ber. 23
<sup>b</sup> דאזמניה למֵיצַר … צָר וכ' which he designated to wrap T’fillin in; if he did so &c. (v. צְרַר).—Part. צָאֵיר צָיֵיר. Y. Ber. IV, 7
<sup>c</sup> top הוה צ' גולתיה וכ' tied Rab’s cloak up &c.; Y. Taan. IV, 67
<sup>c</sup>.—Part. pass. צָיִיר, צָיִר, צָאִיר. Targ. Job XLI, 7.—Ḥull. 105
<sup>b</sup> כל מילי דצייר וחתים whatever is tied up or sealed. B. Mets. 24

<entry id="R00384">
<head-word>צִיֵּן</head-word>
<head-word>צִיֵּין</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of צִיּוּן) 
<italic>to put up a pile, to mark</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shek. I, 1; M. Kat. I, 2 (2
<sup>a</sup>) מְצַיְּינִין על הקברות Y. ed. (Bab. ed. a. Mish. את; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2) graves are marked (with lime). Ib. 5
<sup>b</sup> שדה … קבר וצִיְּינוּהָ (not דצ') a field in which a grave was lost, and which they marked. Maas. Sh. V, 1 כרם רבעי מציינין וכ' a vineyard in the fourth year is marked with clods of earth, … and graves with lime &c. Y. Shek. I, 46
<sup>a</sup> top (ref. to M. Kat. I, 2) לא כבר צִיְּינוּ מאדר had they not marked them in Adar? Ib. (ref. to ובנה, Ez. XXXIX, 15) מיכן שמציינין ע"ג אבן קבועה from this we learn that the mark is put on a fixed stone; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְצוּיָּין, מְצוּיָּן; f. מְצוּיֶּינֶת, מְצוּיֶּנ'; 
<plural-form>Pl. מְצוּיָּינִים, מְצוּיָּינִין; מְצוּיָּינֹות, מְצוּיָּנ'</plural-form>. Ib.; Tosef. ib. I, 5 מצא אבן אחת מצ' וכ' if one found a single stone marked, although this ought not to be done (several stones surrounding the marked spot being required by law) &c.; M. Kat. 6
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. 5
<sup>b</sup> מצא שדה אחת מצ' וכ' if one found a field marked, and knows not for what purpose; a. fr.—[Lev. R. s. 6 מציינין, v. צָוַץ.]—Trnsf. 
<italic>to distinguish, make prominent, adorn</italic>.—Part. pass. as ab. Gen. R. s. 85, v. פָּתִיל. Sabb. 145
<sup>b</sup> מפני מה … מצ' why are the scholars in Babylonia distinguished (in their dress)? Ber. 8
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to שערי ציון, Ps. LXXXVII, 2) שערים המצ' בהלכה gates prominent for learned decisions. Sifré Deut. 43 (ref. to Jer. XXXI, 20) היו מצ' במצות וכ' distinguish yourselves by observing (in exile) religious laws (meant for Palestine), so that they be not new to you, when you return; a. fr.—[Cant. R. to VI, 4; Yalk. Num. 713, read: מְצוּיָּירוֹת, v. צוּר II.]</notes></sense></senses>

<sup>a</sup> צניתא. Snh. 96
